searchText: <@211091239112671234> just saw your proposal for EIP-7610. If we agree to this, it would become our third "retroactively applied from genesis" EIP, along with 2681 and 3607. At n=3, it starts to feel like we should have more than a sub-table in the README of the spec 😅 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/?tab=readme-ov-file#ethereum-protocol-releases Curious how people think we could keep track of these, and if we should have a (soft?) rule of editing things like the Yellow Paper when we agree to such changes. Could potentially make it a "Living" Meta EIP? We should update the yp and the eel and the tests. Most of these 'retro' changes are really theoretical cases that have plenty test coverage but zero realworld impact One idea I've had now that EIPs are split from ERCs is maybe Core EIPs should have a `fork` field that has to be set when they are Final, so this way you could set it to `genesis` for these looking into archival options of 4844 blobs: https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/5882 reminder there is a breakout call on ePBS in about 16 hrs i left a suggested agenda here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/953#issuecomment-1939648921

excerpts.content:
<@211091239112671234> just saw your proposal for EIP-7610. If we agree to this, it would become our third "retroactively applied from genesis" EIP, along with 2681 and 3607. At n=3, it starts to feel like we should have more than a sub-table in the README of the spec 😅  https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/?tab=readme-ov-file#ethereum-protocol-releases

Curious how people think we could keep track of these, and if we should have a (soft?) rule of editing things like the Yellow Paper when we agree to such changes. Could potentially make it a "Living" Meta EIP?
